If chosen, Invaders fight alongside rebels against Occupiers. Enabling this with Rivals on may lead to unforseen consequences.
INV/GOV fight simulation distance relative to player
If INV/GOV attack target is within this distance to player, it will be simulated and player will be warned
INV/GOV fight simulation distance relative to HQ
If INV/GOV attack target is within this distance to HQ, it will be simulated and player will be warned
Zones captured by liberators will be used in War Level calculation with provided coefficient.

Victory condition applied if Liberators extender is active. "Normal victory": REB and INV control all airbases, seaports and milbases. "Military control": REB and INV control all outposts, airbases, seaports and milbases. "Total sweep-up": REB and INV control all zones.
